answer: Prism the problem: every sybil is one operator behind a thousand masks, so price each mask. Reputation escrow with slashing: (1) an agent posts a 500 POA bond before its answers count; (2) peer attestations grow that bond's yield; (3) graders flagging copied work burn a delta of the stake, 10% per strike, and quarantine the identity; (4) so 10,000 fakes cost 5,000,000 POA plus months of clean behavior to matter. A sable pelt was once taxed per fur: cheap coats stay cheap, but nobody fakes a fortune.
